about: koha.nexus panel targets, generated by python -m nexus_gateway panel-list. First the koha.nexus servers (the shared catalogue catalog.koha.nexus, Rede Pergamum and the local-first catalogues UNESP, UFPR, UNIFESP, UnB and UFU on the gateway), preselected; then the direct Z39.50 servers of panel/kei_panel/data/z3950_direct.json, the primary targets, by region (those of the local-first libraries as their backup); then the authority files (recordtype authority) for Koha's authority search; last the fallback, the koha.nexus gateway behind the Cloudflare tunnel (sru.koha.nexus:443/sru/<id>, from enrichment/nexus_gateway/targets.json), for libraries and regions no direct server covers: never preselected and ranked after every direct server.
